blocks.text: Computer programming woh kaam hai jis mein hum hidayaat (instructions) ka aisa set banate hain jo computer ko batata hai ke koi kaam kaise karna hai. Yeh hidayaat ek programming language mein likhi jati hain jise computer samajh kar chala (execute kar) sakta hai. Isay aise samjhein jaise aap kisi dost ko apne ghar ka raasta bata rahe hon: aap ko saaf aur bilkul theek (precise) batana hota hai ta ke dost bhatak na jaye. Isi tarah program likhte waqt hum computer ko saaf aur theek hidayaat dete hain ta ke woh khaas kaam poora kare.

blocks.prompt: Program ki hidayaat saaf aur durust kyun honi chahiyein?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke computer un par bilkul waisa hi chalta hai; mubham ya ghalat hidayat, dost ko ghalat raasta batane ki tarah, ghalat nateeja deti hai.

items: Programming: computer ke liye hidayaat ka set likhna.
Hidayaat saaf aur precise honi chahiyein.
